yeah all these things have been thoroughly discussed by many people for many years. RJ wanted to create a world where our myths and legends came from fact, while our facts and history could inspire their myths and legends. lenn who flew to the moon in an eagle, and his daughter salya who walked among the stars is an old story from the first age. (john glenn. the first moon lander was called the eagle. sally ride was also an astronaught) Ogier are not from randland, they came from somewhere else before the age of legends. The old tonge name for the the Ogier is alantin. the ogier say know that some ages they spend in randland, others in other worlds. alantin...atlantis. In tanchico there are murals of giraffs and stuff. there are a ton of these. You could probably get a doctorate in literature writing about the many many parrallells between randland and our world, many of these probably haven't been discovered yet, hidding in some forgotten sentance fragment in some random paragraph.
